name_en: Dismantling of Temporary Steel Platform & ELS

work_steps.step: Use of flame cutting for temp steel platform & ELS disassembly

control_measures: Workers wear long sleeve clothing, leather gloves and flame cutting mask for body protection
Use flame-resistant plating to shield off flying sparks (especially at areas close to Logos Academy)
Provide blower fan to ventilate toxic fumes
Provide workers with N95 mask
Operation area to be fenced-off with warning signs displayed.
Flame cutting set must be equipped with flashback arrestor, non-return valve, pressure regulator with pressure gauges
Daily checking for gas leakage using soap water
Replace any worn out & damaged gas hose
All flame cutting  cylinders must be secured on trolley or cages & isolated from heat source
Safety personnel enforce hot work permit system
Only workers with valid certificate & appointed by site safety department are allowed to conduct flame cutting
Valve keys of pressure regulator must not be left unattended at flame cutting set.
Cover cylinders with canvas to avoid direct sunlight

hazards.hazard: eye discomfort and burns from the intense light and heat
control_measures: Use protective eyewear (flame cutting mask with polarized glasses)
Set up rest time for workers (5 mins/ hour)
Stop work immediately when workers feel uncomfortable for their eyes
Shield off area with non-reflective paint

work_steps.step: Lifting dismantled section of steel platform & ELS member using tower crane

control_measures: No over-capacity lifting
Do not temper any safety device
Ensure clear lifting route
No lifting during heavy rain, typhoon signal No. 3 or above
Check load chart to ensure sufficient lifting capacity
Check crane in safe working order before work commencement
Stop lifting when abnormalities are observed.
Do not use crane for pulling purpose.
All Lifting Gear must process valid certificate
Use color code system
Daily checking of all LG before use
Proper rigging method to be used
Discard all damaged LG, especially webbing sling & steel wires
Ensure ELS are fully disengaged before lifting.

work_steps.step: Lifting dismantled section of steel platform & ELS member using tower crane (continue)

control_measures: Tower crane & its operator must process valid certificate.
Operator perform daily check and to fill in LA/LG Form 1 and & in-house checklist
No over-capacity lifting
Do not temper any safety device on tower crane
Ensure clearance of lifting path
Do not use tower crane for pulling purpose
Lifting zone to be left fenced-off and with warning size displayed.
Do not use tower crane for pulling purpose
Ensure ELS are fully disengaged before lifting.

hazards.hazard: Injury caused by unauthorized entry of fence-off area
control_measures: Operation area to be fenced-off with warning signs displayed
Work must be stopped upon unauthorized entry is found
Site personnel to confirm no other works to be performed within fence-off area。
Site foreman to be on watch to prohibit unauthorized entry
Use double-end guide rope
Do not use crane for pulling purpose
Workers must not stand directly in front of the path of suspended ELS member
No lifting during heavy rain, typhoon signal No. 3 or above
All personnel (crane operator, banksman, rigger) must process valid certificates
No sudden movement of crane during lifting
Mark out all “dead zone” in operation area and inform all workers during pre-work safety briefing.
Blow whistle to inform all workers before lifting
Place solid wooden blocks at unloading area to avoid toes and fingers being struck by suspended ELS .

hazards.hazard: Injury caused by unauthorized entry of fence-off area
control_measures: Operation area to be fenced-off with warning signs displayed
Work must be stopped upon unauthorized entry is found
Site personnel to confirm no other works to be performed within fence-off area。
Site foreman to be on watch to prohibit unauthorized entry
All LG must proves valid certificate
All personnel (crane operator, banksman, rigger) must process valid certificates for their assigned tasks
Use guide ropes
Daily checking of all LG before use
Do not use LG for pulling purpose
No lifting during heavy rain, typhoon signal No. 3 & strong wind over 13 m/s
Ensure clearance of lifting path.
Pre-work checking of walkie-talkie for effective communication
All suspended loads are hoist up at about 1m from ground to check for entanglement and secure rigging
Use double wrapper rigging
Lifting supervisors to supervise all lifting operations.
Blow whistle to inform all workers
At least 40mm clearance has to be made between edge of I-beam & edge of lifting eye to avoid buckling
Use material skip to hoist small objects (<1m)
Provide sufficient lighting during operation
Disassembly work to be stopped before 8am & after 6pm during short daylight season

work_steps.step: Dismantling of ELS trust & temp. steel platform using mobile working platform

hazards.hazard: Injury of personnel due to unauthorized use of mobile working platform
control_measures: Only personnel trained by mobile working platform supplier and to be appointed by site are allowed to use mobile working platform
Do not modify mobile working platform
Do not attempt to repair mobile working platform when malfunction occurs
Fence off working area of mobile working platform with warning signs displayed.
Keys must be removed when mobile working platform is not in use.

work_steps.step: Dismantling of ELS trust & temp. steel platform using mobile working platform (continue)

control_measures: Operation area of mobile working platform to be fenced-off with warning signs displayed.
Identity area of movement for mobile working platform before work is commenced.
All workers must wear full body harness with double lanyard.
All mobile working platform process valid LA/LG Form 4/5
Mobile working platform to be inspected by operator and to sign LA/LG Form 1
List SWL & maximum number of person permitted.
Do not temper any safety device on mobile working platform
Only use mobile platform on level ground.
Do not use mobile platform for pulling or tugging purpose.
Ensure mobile working platform is lowered and keys removed when not in use.
Do not move mobile working platform when the platform is raised
Use ropes to secure raised platform
Only workers trained by mobile working platform provider are allowed to operate the particular type of platform.
Displayed the name list of qualified operators on the mobile working platform
Steel platform & ELS disassembly fenced-off with warning signs displayed.
All workers must wear full body harness with fall arrestor and attached to independent life line anchored to secure point
When removing sheet pile decking on platform, pre-fabricate points on sheet pile to allow fall arrest systems to be attached
Each fall arrest system is for one worker only
Use mobile working platform for ELS disassembly works
Workers must not over extend their bodies over mobile working platform
DO NOT walk or sit on I-beam
